correction_reason: The exact PRE_STRUCTURED v3 file is race-level JSONL: top-level rows expose race_id and an entrants container; the four authorized rider fields are nested inside entrant objects. This nesting was already established by the prior schema-only audit. The first mechanical parser decoded only authorized top-level race_id values and key names, did not descend into entrants, and therefore decoded no entrant car_no/class/style/score values. This correction freezes selective structural traversal before any nested entrant value access.
pre_value_guards: exact SHA256 must equal preregistered hash
recursively enumerate key names only while traversing structure and fail closed on forbidden key tokens
decode no value for any key outside race_id/car_no/class/style/score
do not read withdrawn or any other PRE feature value

decision_rule.PASS_MECHANICAL_COMPATIBILITY: hash matches; forbidden-key scan clear; all authorized fields present with compatible types/support; at least one valid 7-unique-car race produces finite nonnegative ordered-top3 probabilities whose total mass differs from 1 by <=1e-10
decision_rule.FAIL_CLOSED: identity/hash mismatch, forbidden key, unsupported authorized-field type/support, malformed structural parse, zero valid races, or probability sanity failure; no tuning after failure

persistence_rule: Persist aggregate counts and sanity metrics only; no real PRE row values and no per-race probability payloads.
